name: Reject dot segments
description: Platform flow rejecting any request whose path carries dot segments, encoded or not.

pre.name: Reject dot segments
pre.description: Interrupts the request before its plan is enforced and before the backend is invoked.

configuration.script:
import io.gravitee.policy.groovy.PolicyResult.State
String path = request.path.toLowerCase()
if (path.contains('..') || path.contains('%2e')) {
    result.state = State.FAILURE
    result.code = 400
    result.error = 'Request path contains dot segments'
}
